_about: Prompts for triggers.py. expect: the skill that should fire first (mcenerney-lens, effective-writing) or none. kind: named (names the skill), mcenerney (says McEnerney), plain (everyday wording), near-miss (close to a skill's job but not it). {paragraph} and {sentence} are filled in from below; prompts that mention paper.pdf get a short paper in the working folder.
paragraph: Large-eddy simulation of turbulent premixed flames relies on subgrid-scale models to represent the unresolved scalar flux. This study uses direct numerical simulation data to evaluate several eddy-viscosity closures across a range of Karlovitz numbers. The results are presented in Section 4. It is shown that the closures differ in how they predict counter-gradient transport.
sentence: The datas shows that the flame are thicker then expected at high Karlovitz number.
